ppi_oneshot.replay_instruction: Rebuild observations only from this frozen raw document. Do not refetch these seven PPI series.

bea_line_335.name: Passenger fares for foreign travel
bea_line_335.source_text: Weighted average of BLS import price index for air travel and PPI for international scheduled air passenger fares.

primary_source.table: BEA Table 2.4.4 U-D. Price Indexes for PCE: Source Data

handbook.document: NIPA Handbook Chapter 5, Table 5.B, line 109 Foreign travel by U.S. residents
handbook.price_text: Travel expenditures: BEA composite index of foreign CPIs (exchange-rate adjusted). Passenger fare imports: BLS import price index for air passenger fares. Passenger fare payments to U.S. carriers: PPI for international scheduled passenger air transportation.

blocked_because: Table 2.4.4 U-D names a weighted average and does not publish the two source proportions.
Handbook Chapter 5 identifies the two indexes as prices for two expenditure pieces and does not publish the line-335 monthly weights.
Seasonal status is SA by BEA. Both BLS inputs verified below are not seasonally adjusted. No September 2026 BEA seasonal factor for E1AFT1 is in the source map.
A convex combination of the NSA legs is therefore not a BEA-equivalent component rate.
required_for_central_revision: Primary nonnegative weights on the import-air index and the international scheduled PPI that sum to one inside line 335 and match the PCE consumer concept.
A documented BEA seasonal factor or SA index for September 2026 versus August 2026 for that same composite.
Explicit confirmation that no third price leg enters line 335.

lines_not_updated.207: PPI Domestic scheduled passenger air transportation. Not the import air passenger fare index.
lines_not_updated.336: BEA composite of foreign CPIs, exchange-rate adjusted. Not an import-price leg.
lines_not_updated.339: Fixed-weighted travel CPIs and PPIs for domestic scheduled air passenger fares and travel agencies. Negative PCE weight. Import air fares are not a named leg.

import_leg.series_title: Monthly import price index for balance of payments V142, Air passenger fares, not seasonally adjusted

release.program: U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes
release.technical_note: All indexes use a modified Laspeyres formula and are not seasonally adjusted. Index values are rounded to the tenth. Percent changes are derived from the rounded indexes and then rounded to the tenth.

international_ppi_leg.series_title: PPI industry data for Scheduled passenger air transportation-International, not seasonally adjusted
international_ppi_leg.footnote_text: Preliminary. All indexes are subject to monthly revisions up to four months after original publication.
international_ppi_leg.note: Retrieved from the BLS public API on 2026-10-16. Not one of the seven series in the frozen PPI one-shot raw document. Do not mix with the earlier FRED August print of 280.421.

nsa_proxy_envelope_not_a_central_revisio.label: nsa_proxy_envelope_not_bea_sa
nsa_proxy_envelope_not_a_central_revisio.formula: For every unpublished import-leg share w in [0, 1], NSA proxy mom = w*import_index_ratio_mom + (1-w)*ppi_index_ratio_mom. Contribution delta = line_335_weight * (proxy_mom - carried_mom). Report only the signed endpoints. Do not choose w. Do not replace the central.
